* This world has the alternate orthography: ''Poroszlo''. {{Page cite|name= Mercenary  |page=21 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CTMerc1}} 
* ''Porozlo'' is known to many as ''Warworld''. {{Page cite|name= Mercenary  |page=21 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CTMerc1}}
* This world is a member of the [[Rhylanor Cluster]]. 
* The bright supergiant star [[Deneb (star)|Deneb]] is visible in Porozlo's sky even during the daytime.

=== System Data ===
The worlds of the [[system]] have been surveyed. They consist of:
* The [[mainworld]].
* x9 secondary [[world|rocky worlds]].
* x1 [[gas giant]].

=== Mainworld Data ===
'''Porozlo''' orbits within its star's [[habitable zone]].
* It receives moderate levels of [[Electromagnetic Spectrum|stellar energy]].

==== [[Atmosphere|Mainworld Atmosphere]] (A) ====
{{WorldAtmo|name= Porozlo|Atmosphere= 6}}
* It experiences [[Celsius|generally moderate temperatures]]. The second sun in the system has some climatological and meteorological effects at the times of its planetary periastron.

==== [[Hydrosphere|Mainworld Hydrosphere]] (H) ====
{{WorldHydro|name= Porozlo|Hydrosphere= 7}}

==== Mainworld Geography and Topography ====
'''Porozlo''' is considered to be a [[Garden World]], with ideal living conditions for most [[sophont]]s with biological and environmental needs similar to [[Humaniti]], supporting a range of climatological and topographical environments inhabited by a significant range of biodiversity. The ''Karamak Mountain Range'' separates two of the major nation-states of Porozlo (each lying on opposite sides of the range).

=== Politics & Government ===

==== [[Government|World Government]] (G) ====
{{WorldGov|name= Porozlo|Government=7}}  

Major nations of Porozlo include ''Stepozhevac'' and ''Morovic'' (each on opposite sides of the ''Karamak Mountains''). {{Page cite|name= Mercenary  |page=21 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CTMerc1}} Other nations of Porozlo include ''Nemso'' (formerly a member of the ''PO-bloc'') and ''Anasinta'' (neutral, but leaning towards the ''PO-bloc''). {{Page cite|name= 76 Patrons  |page=22, 25 & 43 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CT76 Patrons1}}

* The '''Private Ownership bloc''' (PO-bloc), which comprises about two fifths of the nations and over half the population of the planet, severely limits the size of corporate concerns by intensive regulation, fearing the ability of large multi-world concerns to influence and dominate local governments. {{Page cite|name= Mercenary  |page=21 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CTMerc1}}

* The '''Free Commerce bloc''' (FC-bloc) contains fewer nations, but is generally more industrialized and technologically advanced, and does not impose limits as do the PO-bloc nations. {{Page cite|name= Mercenary  |page=21 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CTMerc1}}

==== [[Military|World Military]] ====
While all-out war has been avoided, constant brushfire wars erupt in the smaller nations of the world, as each side seeks to convert the other to its views.  As a result, mercenaries have given Porozlo the nickname ''"Warworld"''. {{Page cite|name= Mercenary  |page=21 |version=Classic Traveller |citeName= CTMerc1}}

The system was the site of a major military engagement during the [[Third Frontier War]]: the [[Battle of Porozlo]], which resulted in an important [[Zhodani]] victory.

=== World Population (P) ===
{{WorldPop|name= Porozlo|multiplier= 2|Population= A}}

==== World Demographics ====
Humaniti, population 95% 
* Other Sophonts, population 5%

==== Linguistic Topography ====
The following [[language]]s are most commonly heard:
* ''[[Riftian|Riftian Galanglic]]:'' ''A regional dialect of one of the two official languages of the'' ''{{Imperium}}''.
* ''[[Vilani (language)|Vilani]]:'' ''One of the two official languages of the'' ''{{Imperium}}''.
* ''Regional ethnic dialects descended from the original settlers:''
:» ''[[:Category:Baltoslavic Dialect|Baltoslavic Dialect]]s. 
:» ''Various [[:Category:French Dialect|Southern Francophone Dialect]]s and/or [[Latin (language)|Italo-Romance Dialect]]s''.
:» ''Various [[:Category:East Afrasian Dialect|East Afrasian Dialect]]s and [[:Category:West Afrasian Dialect|West Afrasian Dialect]]s''.

==== [[Cultural Extension|World Culture]] [Cx] ====
* Heterogenity: 8 (discordant)
* Acceptance:   D (very xenophilic)
* Strangeness:  3 (somewhat typical)
* Symbols:      9 (somewhat abstract)

Many nations of the world were settled by peoples of at least partial Solomani extraction, and based on the evidence of the names of both the world and the nation-states, by peoples with at least some ethnic background favoring the ''[[Wikipedia: Ugric|Ugric]]'' and ''[[Wikipedia: Balto-Slavic|Western Baltoslavic]]'' peoples. Later settlement patterns have added to the ethnic mix of both Solomani and non-Solomani ethnicities.

==== Urbanization ====
In addition to ''Porozlo Startown'', other major settlements on Porozlo include ''Geeka'', ''Seka'', ''Manier'', ''Bargugu'', ''Shununu'', and ''Irmudad''.

== World History & Background ==
The world of Porozlo was first officially settled by Imperial colonists during the early waves of Imperial settlement in the [[Spinward Marches Sector]] in the [[300s]], becoming an Imperial Client State not long afterward and completely absorbed as a full Imperial member world by ca [[400]]. 

=== World Timeline ===
Major events that have affected this world and the wider region that it lies within:
* [[0|The Year 0]]: The [[Third Imperium]] is founded.
* [[300]]-[[420]]: The {{Imperial}} [[First Survey]] charts the system.
* [[522]]: [[Emperor]] [[Jerome]] creates the [[Duchy of Rhylanor]].
* [[589]]-[[604]]: [[First Frontier War]].
* [[602]]: [[Arbellatra Khatami Alkhalikoi]] inherits the [[Duchy of Rhylanor]] upon the death of her father.
* [[604]]: [[Battle of Rhylanor (1FW)|Battle of Rhylanor <small>(1FW)</small>]]. 
* [[604]]-[[622]]: The {{Imperial}} [[Civil War]]. "[[Emperors of the Flag]]".
* [[615]]-[[620]]: [[Second Frontier War]].
* [[624]]: The [[Express Boat Network]] is established.
* [[979]]-[[986]]: [[Third Frontier War]].
* [[986]]: [[Battle of Porozlo]] <small>(3FW)</small>. [[Third Frontier War]] ends after Zhodani drive at Rhylanor is turned back with reinforcements from [[Sabine Subsector]] in the [[Deneb Sector]].
* [[995]]-[[1065]]: The {{Imperial}} [[Second Survey]] charts the system.
* [[1065]]: The [[Second Survey]] is published. Information about the system becomes widely available.
* [[1082]]-[[1084]]: [[Fourth Frontier War]], also known as the ''False War''.
* [[1107]]-[[1110]]: [[Fifth Frontier War]].
* [[1109]]: [[Battle of Rhylanor (5FW)|Battle of Rhylanor <small>(5FW)</small>]]. Major fleet battle involving both fleet and planetary elements of Imperial and Colonial forces and the Imperial Corridor Fleet vs. the Zhodani 40th Fleet.
